notes.title: 250603补丁
notes.content:
1.增强了【旁白】的引导以及游戏进程中的引导提示
2.修改了一些显示bug
3.调整部分逻辑细节
4.调整了存档错误，新游戏会跳过前置流程的bug
5.修改了一些物品使用后无反馈的错误

很抱歉游戏中产生的各种问题，感谢大家的批评与建议，我们会继续修改调整错误，努力做的更好，为此造成的困扰我们深表歉意。
如游戏中遇到任何bug或是问题，可以加如官群反馈，再次感谢大家的支持！
官群：174697501

notes.title: The crowdfunding lottery for 'False Words' has started!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Our game 'False Words' has officially launched a crowdfunding campaign on MoDian website!
The surrounding gifts will be out of print in this crowdfunding campaign. All participants will appear on the official thank you list. Please make sure to leave the correct ID in the remarks, otherwise the default ID will be used. Thank you very much for your support.
For more information about crowdfunding, please refer to the MoDian details page. Thank you in advance for your support and support!

传送门：https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/135792
